title: Nvidia Launches AI Tools to Speed Chip Workflows by 50x
summary:
Synopsys, KLA and Applied Materials are integrating new artificial intelligence into their chip design and fabrication processes. Nvidia's CUDA-X tools target semiconductor design, manufacturing and factory automation, with the company reporting speed improvements of up to 50x in selected workflows. Other early adopters of the software include Cadence and Lam Research.

The move marks a strategic expansion beyond powering AI data centers toward transforming the physical production of semiconductors. By applying AI to factory automation, the company is extending its influence into the foundational design and manufacturing stages of the chip supply chain.

NVIDIA UNVEILS AI TOOLS TO TRANSFORM CHIP MANUFACTURING

Nvidia ($NVDA ) is launching new CUDA-X AI tools to accelerate semiconductor design, manufacturing and factory automation.

Major companies, including Synopsys, Cadence, Applied Materials, Lam Research and KLA, are adopting the technology, with Nvidia reporting speed improvements of up to 50x in selected workflows.

The bigger picture: Nvidia is expanding beyond powering AI data centers to using AI to transform how semiconductors themselves are designed and manufactured.
